text:
emma_sales: Kicking off HelioBank POC tomorrow AM. Key asks: low-latency streaming, function/tool-calls, strict JSON schema for outputs, SAML SSO + customer-managed KMS, and reserved capacity for ~1k steady QPS. Need a runnable demo in 48h and a procurement-friendly cost estimate.

raj_engineer: We can assemble a Node + Go streaming demo that shows WS streaming + tool-calls within 48h. Will include a replay driver to simulate sustained 1k QPS and a short script to measure p50/p95. Example WS handshake for demo: 
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-2');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({input: 'parse_payment', stream: true})));
ws.on('message', msg => console.log('recv', msg));
```

maria_se: For structured output, we should demo function-calling with explicit JSON Schema and show an on-the-fly validator rejecting mismatches. Example function payload: 
```json
{"tool":"extract_payment","args":{"payer":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}
```
We'll also show a 422 structured error when schema fails: `{"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","expected":"/args/amount","received":"string"}}`.

raj_engineer: Ops notes: Recommend dedicated pool + small batching window for cost/latency tradeoff. Batching window ~20ms gives good throughput without blowing tail latency. Fallback: route overflow to a lower-cost model variant. For creds: API uses ephemeral tokens (STS) TTL 15m-1h. SAML for console + SCIM onboarding for users. KMS: support AWS/GCP/azure CMKs + HSM.

tim_solutions: Action list: (1) Raj: Node + Go streaming samples + replay tool, (2) Maria: schema + validator UI, (3) Tim: coordinate infra/KMS/SSO + confirm demo env. Can we have demo endpoints by EOD?

emma_sales: Also need a procurement-facing cost delta: reserved pool (steady 1k QPS) vs hosted autoscale with batching. Give a ballpark monthly number to share.

raj_engineer: Ballpark for 1k QPS text gen: dedicated (4x A100 equiv) ~ "\$34k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching and prefix caching ~ "\$21k/mo". I'll produce a token-based calc with sample prompts.

sara_legal: I'll need the security questionnaire filled. Please upload Helio's infosec pack to our OneTrust link: https://onetrust.example.com/helio-upload. They asked for SOC2 report, KMS controls, and data residency notes. I'll attach the NDA and standard security packet.

infra_bot: docs: Streaming SDKs -> https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming  |  Tool/Function calls -> https://docs.redwood.ai/tool-calls  |  KMS integration -> https://docs.redwood.ai/kms-integration

maria_se: Demo tip: show how the client can validate server-returned schema and auto-retry with a corrected prompt. Also demo structured fallback where system emits `{"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"amount"}]}` so integrators can map to UX flows.

tim_solutions: Timeline: collect Helio questions this afternoon, perf replay + numbers tomorrow morning, live demo 3pm PT. I will loop in support if we hit infra caps.

emma_sales: Great. I'll ask Helio to share sample prompts and their security contact now. @sara_legal I'll send the NDA. :thumbsup: 

raj_engineer: Quick config snippet we'll show for routing + batching: 
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: incoming.traffic.high
    capacity: reserved:helios-01
    fallback: redwood-lite
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefix_cache: true
```

emma_sales: Thanks team. Ping me if anything blocks getting the demo ready. I'll update the Helio deck with these points and the cost slide.
